title: DOW-UAP-D083, Narrative Statement 5, Western United States Event, 2023
doc_notes: This document is a memorandum from the Office of the Under Secretary of War containing a first-hand narrative from a federal law enforcement agent regarding UAP sightings in October 2023.

incidents.summary: Witness observed a large orange light hovering over a ridge line at sunset.
incidents.quote: It seemed to be hovering with zero resistance or movement, or to be suspended just over a distinctive peak in the ridge line.

incidents.summary: Witness observed a large red orb release two smaller red orbs that moved away before all lights vanished.
incidents.quote: I am certain I saw two red, smaller orbs release from the larger one going west

incidents.summary: Witness observed a large red orb again, followed by a white flash of light in the sky.
incidents.quote: We continued to hike west up the road and saw the large orb again, at 1937

incidents.summary: Witness observed a red and white light pair hovering over bushes, which later appeared as a thin horizontal line in NVGs.
incidents.quote: the red and white light pair hovered, with zero resistance, or change in height, over the bushes

incidents.summary: Witness observed a formation of faint lights moving together in the air.
incidents.quote: faint lights in a perfect formation that moved together
